from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyMetricValue(BaseModel):
    """One company's value for the target financial metric from a single report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The full company name as reported")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/security code, if provided")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The metric label as written in the report")
    metric_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the metric")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the metric value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_metric_values: list[CompanyMetricValue]
